title: 5.4.1 Animated Sprites
description: Cycle frames procedurally: rotate, scale, recolor. A lightweight taste of animation without sprite sheets.

steps.title: Time as a wave
steps.instructions: Use frameCount with Math.sin / Math.cos to animate properties smoothly. E.g. sprite.scale = 1 + 0.3 * Math.sin(frameCount / 10).
hints: frameCount is a world global, incremented each frame.

steps.title: Rotate over time
steps.instructions: sprite.rotation = frameCount / 30 — spins at a constant rate.
hints: rotation is in radians. 2*Math.PI is one full turn.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instructions: Rotate, scale-breathe, and color-pulse simultaneously. You've got a disco sprite.
